scientific_boundary.purpose: Assign each of the twelve formal declarations underlying the ten advertised advances to exactly one SFT branch before any translation, derivation, verdict or admission attempt.
scientific_boundary.one_owner_law: Every atomic proposition has one primary categorical owner. Other branches may supply typed dependencies but may not duplicate ownership.

rows.title: Sharp Cohn-Elkies sphere-packing asymptotics
rows.owner_reason: The proposition concerns packing, finite-dimensional geometry, harmonic transforms and a generated-dimension limit; no physical measurement or computational resource class is asserted.

rows.title: Strict improvement over the MRRW binary-code bound
rows.owner_reason: The proposition is an extremal finite-word packing and generated-length rate comparison. Information Science may consume the bound but does not own its combinatorial proof.

rows.title: Strict hierarchy of improved spherical-code bounds
rows.owner_reason: The proposition is an extremal geometric-code and rate-order statement. It supplies a mathematical bound rather than an information-channel observation.

rows.title: Existence of a finitely presented non-sofic group
rows.owner_reason: The proposition concerns group presentation, permutation approximation and algebraic existence.

rows.title: Infinitely many nonisomorphic property-(T) groups with isomorphic factors
rows.owner_reason: The proposition concerns abstract groups, representations, operators, measures and isomorphism; it asserts no physical quantum observation.

rows.title: Permanent lower bounds for rational formulas with division
rows.owner_reason: The conclusion is a formula-resource lower bound. Mathematics owns the polynomial carrier; Computation owns circuit/formula cost and lower-bound transport.

rows.title: Uniform exponential quantum parallel repetition
rows.owner_reason: The proposition concerns entangled games, repeated quantum strategies and quantum resource scaling.

rows.title: Polynomial-factor NP-hardness of the closest-vector problem
rows.owner_reason: Mathematics owns exact lattices and squared distance; Computation owns the promise problem, reduction, resource accounting and hardness verdict.

rows.title: Sharp Ehrhart volume inequality
rows.owner_reason: The proposition concerns convex geometry, lattice interiors, barycentric balance and volume bounds.

rows.title: Explicit superexponential lower bound for multicolour triangle Ramsey numbers
rows.owner_reason: The proposition is a finite colouring construction with a generated-colour-count succession bound.

rows.title: Quantitative counterexample to the Erdos-Simonovits compactness conjecture
rows.owner_reason: The proposition concerns finite graph families, forbidden subgraphs and extremal edge counts.

rows.title: Quantitative counterexample for two-degenerate bipartite graphs
rows.owner_reason: The proposition concerns finite graph degeneracy, bipartition structure and extremal edge growth.
